name: Philippines
description: The Philippines from its island peoples to Magellan and Spanish rule, revolution, American rule, war, People Power and today.

checkpoints.name: The islands
checkpoints.note: Austronesian seafarers settled the islands. Rice terraces climbed the mountains of Luzon, and trading states dealt with China and the Malay world.

checkpoints.name: Spanish rule
checkpoints.note: Magellan arrived in 1521, and Spain founded Manila in 1571 and made the islands Catholic. Galleons carried silver and silk across the Pacific, and Rizal's writings inspired revolt.

checkpoints.name: America and war
checkpoints.note: The United States bought the islands from Spain and crushed the new republic. Japan occupied them in 1942, and Leyte Gulf saw the largest sea battle in history.

checkpoints.name: The republic
checkpoints.note: The Philippines became independent in 1946. Marcos ruled under martial law until People Power drove him out in 1986, and democracy has endured since.
